name: CHYMOMERG D Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CHYMOMERG D TABLET

CHYMOMERG D TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, Trypsin and Diclofenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteases, Flavonoids, Proteolytic enzymes and Analgesics respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, sports injuries, tooth extraction. CHYMOMERG D TABLET is also used to manage post-surgical inflammation and helps in wound healing and has an anti-scarring effect.

Prior to starting the management with CHYMOMERG D TABLET, your doctor might want you to take up several diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

CHYMOMERG D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney or liver disorders, high blood pressure, bleeding or clotting disorders, blood in vomiting or urine and infection. It should be taken with caution in patients who have heart disease.

CHYMOMERG D TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. There is no data on the use of CHYMOMERG D TABLET in children and elderly patients hence, caution must be exercised while taking this medicine. Always, consult with your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking CHYMOMERG D TABLET are nausea, loss of appetite, headache, diarrhoea and flatulence. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Provides relief from pain and inflammation
usesDetails:
Uses Of CHYMOMERG D TABLET
Provides relief from pain and inflammation
mechanismOfAction:
How CHYMOMERG D TABLET Works

CHYMOMERG D TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain is a protease enzyme which decreases inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreases their ability to break down. Diclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug which acts by stopping the release of certain chemicals called prostaglandins which is responsible for the occurrence of pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use CHYMOMERG D TABLET

Take CHYMOMERG D TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CHYMOMERG D TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DISPERZYME TABLET

DISPERZYME TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes and Flavonoids, respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint issues related to inflammation, pain and swelling of joints, swelling associated with surgical wounds, pulmonary edema, ulcerative colitis, sports and accidental injuries, muscular cramps and spasms, tendinitis, bursitis, dental extraction, sinusitis, bronchitis, and rhinitis. 

Prior to starting the management with DISPERZYME TABLET, your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests to understand your existing condition and to safely use this medicine to manage the risk of any unusual effects. 

DISPERZYME TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with hemophilia (a disorder in which blood doesn't clot normally), liver or kidney disorders, or patients undergoing haemodialysis. DISPERZYME TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with any bleeding disorders and heart disease. 

DISPERZYME TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no data on the use of DISPERZYME TABLET in children or elderly patients; hence, always consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. 

The most common side effects of taking DISPERZYME TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, tiredness, dry mouth, and skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CHYMONET FORTE TABLET

CHYMONET FORTE TABLET contains Trypsin-Chymotrypsin which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes. It is used to manage post-operative wounds, necrotic tissue, oedema and haematomas like auricular septal hematoma, nasal fractures, parapharyngeal abscess, management of inflammation of the surgical stitches, pelvic inflammatory disease, caesarean section, episiotomy, hysterectomy, tooth extraction, peri-apical abscess, ocular trauma include fluid build-up in the macula (macular oedema), hyphema (collection of blood in eye), black eye, inflammation of uveal tract (uveitis), broken blood vessels (subconjunctival haemorrhage), degenerative joint disorders like rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, spondylosis, spondylarthritis, pain management, maxillofacial surgery, post-traumatic oedema, soft tissue injury, fractures and dislocation, sports injuries, muscle and joint pain with swelling, sciatica, and sprains and strains.

It is also used to manage chronic respiratory diseases like asthma, bronchitis, lung diseases, and sinus infections. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CHYMONET FORTE TABLET as it may lead to unwanted effects. CHYMONET FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcer, glaucoma, blood clotting disorder, severe liver or kidney disease. CHYMONET FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung diseases, and arrhythmias.

CHYMONET FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless considered necessary. CHYMONET FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. CHYMONET FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in children. CHYMONET FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. The most common side effects of taking CHYMONET FORTE TABLET are nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, bloating, allergy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CHYMONET FORTE TABLET Works

CHYMONET FORTE TABLET works by breaking down the proteins and helps to fight infection and hasten the repair of traumatic, surgical or orthopaedic injuries. It also breaks down the blood clots thus improving and restoring circulation and resolves oedema, hematoma and pain, promotes the removal of the debris and accelerates recovery. It also reduces swelling (oedema), and inflammation, by reducing the proinflammatory mediators and fastens the healing process.

name: Rotozyme Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ROTOZYME TABLET

ROTOZYME TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes and Flavonoids, respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint issues related to inflammation, pain and swelling of joints, swelling associated with surgical wounds, pulmonary edema, ulcerative colitis, sports and accidental injuries, muscular cramps and spasms, tendinitis, bursitis, dental extraction, sinusitis, bronchitis, and rhinitis. 

Prior to starting the management with ROTOZYME TABLET, your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests to understand your existing condition and to safely use this medicine to manage the risk of any unusual effects. 

ROTOZYME TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with hemophilia (a disorder in which blood doesn't clot normally), liver or kidney disorders, or patients undergoing haemodialysis. ROTOZYME TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with any bleeding disorders and heart disease. 

ROTOZYME TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no data on the use of ROTOZYME TABLET in children or elderly patients; hence, always consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. 

The most common side effects of taking ROTOZYME TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, tiredness, dry mouth, and skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROTOZYME TABLET Works

ROTOZYME TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain and trypsin are protease enzymes that decrease inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreasing their ability to break down.
usageDetails:

Take ROTOZYME TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ROTOZYME TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

It is also used to manage chronic respiratory diseases like asthma, bronchitis, lung diseases, and sinus infections. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ORTHAL FORTE TABLET as it may lead to unwanted effects.

ORTHAL FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcer, glaucoma, blood clotting disorder, severe liver or kidney disease. ORTHAL FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung diseases, and arrhythmias.

introduction:
Introduction About ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET

ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, Trypsin and Diclofenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteases, Flavonoids, Proteolytic enzymes and Analgesics respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, sports injuries, tooth extraction. ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET is also used to manage post-surgical inflammation and helps in wound healing and has an anti-scarring effect.

Prior to starting the management with ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET, your doctor might want you to take up several diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney or liver disorders, high blood pressure, bleeding or clotting disorders, blood in vomiting or urine and infection. It should be taken with caution in patients who have heart disease.

ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. There is no data on the use of ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET in children and elderly patients hence, caution must be exercised while taking this medicine. Always, consult with your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET are nausea, loss of appetite, headache, diarrhoea and flatulence. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Provides relief from pain and inflammation
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET
Provides relief from pain and inflammation
mechanismOfAction:
How ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET Works

ENZOMAC PLUS TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain is a protease enzyme which decreases inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreases their ability to break down. Diclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug which acts by stopping the release of certain chemicals called prostaglandins which is responsible for the occurrence of pain and inflammation.

Introduction About K TRIP FORTE TABLET

K TRIP FORTE TABLET contains Trypsin-Chymotrypsin which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes. It is used to manage post-operative wounds, necrotic tissue, oedema and haematomas like auricular septal hematoma, nasal fractures, parapharyngeal abscess, management of inflammation of the surgical stitches, pelvic inflammatory disease, caesarean section, episiotomy, hysterectomy, tooth extraction, peri-apical abscess, ocular trauma include fluid build-up in the macula (macular oedema), hyphema (collection of blood in eye), black eye, inflammation of uveal tract (uveitis), broken blood vessels (subconjunctival haemorrhage), degenerative joint disorders like rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, spondylosis, spondylarthritis, pain management, maxillofacial surgery, post-traumatic oedema, soft tissue injury, fractures and dislocation, sports injuries, muscle and joint pain with swelling, sciatica, and sprains and strains.

It is also used to manage chronic respiratory diseases like asthma, bronchitis, lung diseases, and sinus infections. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking K TRIP FORTE TABLET as it may lead to unwanted effects. K TRIP FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcer, glaucoma, blood clotting disorder, severe liver or kidney disease. K TRIP FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung diseases, and arrhythmias.

K TRIP FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless considered necessary. K TRIP FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. K TRIP FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in children. K TRIP FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. The most common side effects of taking K TRIP FORTE TABLET are nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, bloating, allergy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

Prior to starting the management with CHYMOMERG FORTE TABLET, your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests to understand your existing condition and to safely use this medicine to manage the risk of any unusual effects. 

CHYMOMERG FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with hemophilia (a disorder in which blood doesn't clot normally), liver or kidney disorders, or patients undergoing haemodialysis. CHYMOMERG FORTE TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with any bleeding disorders and heart disease. 

CHYMOMERG FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no data on the use of CHYMOMERG FORTE TABLET in children or elderly patients; hence, always consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. 

The most common side effects of taking CHYMOMERG FORTE TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, tiredness, dry mouth, and skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About DISPERZYME CD TABLET

Disperzyme CD Tablet is a unique blend of Trypsin, Bromelain, and Rutoside, formulated to support the body’s natural recovery process following injuries, surgeries, or inflammatory conditions. This enzyme-based formulation aids in reducing swelling, improving blood flow, and supporting faster tissue repair. It is often recommended to individuals experiencing post-operative inflammation, joint stiffness, or soft tissue injuries, helping them regain comfort and mobility more efficiently. 

The combination of Trypsin and Bromelain, two proteolytic enzymes, works synergistically to break down damaged proteins and enhance healing at the affected site. Rutoside, a bioflavonoid, provides antioxidant and anti-edematous support by strengthening blood vessel walls and reducing fluid leakage into tissues. Together, these components help manage inflammation and promote quicker recovery while maintaining overall tissue health.

Disperzyme CD Tablet is ideally suited for adults recovering from surgical procedures, muscle strain, ligament injuries, or swelling due to trauma. It should be taken as directed by your healthcare professional, usually on an empty stomach or between meals for better absorption. Taking it with food may reduce its effectiveness. Always follow the recommended dose and duration to achieve optimal results.

Before use, individuals should inform their doctor about any existing health conditions or medications. Disperzyme CD Tablet is not recommended during pregnancy and breastfeeding, as safety data are limited. People with kidney, liver, or bleeding disorders, or those allergic to enzyme-based medicines, should use it only under medical supervision. Common side effects may include nausea, mild stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, or allergic reactions, which usually resolve once the medicine is stopped. If persistent symptoms occur, seek medical advice promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How DISPERZYME CD TABLET Works
Mechanism of action of Disperzyme CD tablet

Disperzyme CD Tablet works through a synergistic action of three key components Trypsin, Bromelain, and Rutoside each contributing to reducing inflammation and promoting natural healing.

Trypsin: A proteolytic enzyme that breaks down proteins at the site of injury, helping remove damaged tissue and improve blood flow for faster recovery.
Bromelain: A natural enzyme derived from pineapple that supports the body’s anti-inflammatory response, helping reduce swelling, pain, and fluid build-up in affected tissues.
Rutoside (Rutin): A plant-based antioxidant that strengthens blood vessels, reduces leakage from capillaries, and enhances tissue repair by improving microcirculation.
usageInstructions: Take Disperzyme CD Tablet exactly as advised by your healthcare professional.
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
It is generally recommended to take the tablet on an empty stomach or as directed by your doctor to ensure optimal absorption.
Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent enzyme levels in the body.
Avoid skipping doses; if a dose is missed, take it as soon as you remember skip it if it’s nearly time for your next dose.
Do not self-adjust the dose or duration; follow the prescribed schedule for best results.
Maintain adequate hydration and follow any dietary advice given by your doctor for better recovery outcomes.

introduction:
Introduction About RUTOR D TABLET

RUTOR D TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, Trypsin and Diclofenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteases, Flavonoids, Proteolytic enzymes and Analgesics respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, sports injuries, tooth extraction. RUTOR D TABLET is also used to manage post-surgical inflammation and helps in wound healing and has an anti-scarring effect.

Prior to starting the management with RUTOR D TABLET, your doctor might want you to take up several diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

RUTOR D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney or liver disorders, high blood pressure, bleeding or clotting disorders, blood in vomiting or urine and infection. It should be taken with caution in patients who have heart disease.

RUTOR D TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. There is no data on the use of RUTOR D TABLET in children and elderly patients hence, caution must be exercised while taking this medicine. Always, consult with your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RUTOR D TABLET are nausea, loss of appetite, headache, diarrhoea and flatulence. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Provides relief from pain and inflammation

Provides relief from pain and inflammation
mechanismOfAction:
How RUTOR D TABLET Works

RUTOR D TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain is a protease enzyme which decreases inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreases their ability to break down. Diclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug which acts by stopping the release of certain chemicals called prostaglandins which is responsible for the occurrence of pain and inflammation.

introduction:
Introduction About ETORIFLEX MR 4MG TABLET

ETORIFLEX MR 4MG TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETORIFLEX MR 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ETORIFLEX MR 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

ETORIFLEX MR 4MG TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

name: ENZOHEAL Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About ENZOHEAL TABLET

ENZOHEAL TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes and Flavonoids, respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint issues related to inflammation, pain and swelling of joints, swelling associated with surgical wounds, pulmonary edema, ulcerative colitis, sports and accidental injuries, muscular cramps and spasms, tendinitis, bursitis, dental extraction, sinusitis, bronchitis, and rhinitis. 

Prior to starting the management with ENZOHEAL TABLET, your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests to understand your existing condition and to safely use this medicine to manage the risk of any unusual effects. 

ENZOHEAL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with hemophilia (a disorder in which blood doesn't clot normally), liver or kidney disorders, or patients undergoing haemodialysis. ENZOHEAL TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with any bleeding disorders and heart disease. 

ENZOHEAL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no data on the use of ENZOHEAL TABLET in children or elderly patients; hence, always consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. 

The most common side effects of taking ENZOHEAL TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, tiredness, dry mouth, and skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ENZOHEAL TABLET Works

ENZOHEAL TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain and trypsin are protease enzymes that decrease inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreasing their ability to break down.

Take ENZOHEAL TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ENZOHEAL TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Introduction About CHYMOTRIP TABLET

CHYMOTRIP TABLET contains Trypsin-Chymotrypsin which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes. It is used to manage post-operative wounds, necrotic tissue, oedema and haematomas like auricular septal hematoma, nasal fractures, parapharyngeal abscess, management of inflammation of the surgical stitches, pelvic inflammatory disease, caesarean section, episiotomy, hysterectomy, tooth extraction, peri-apical abscess, ocular trauma include fluid build-up in the macula (macular oedema), hyphema (collection of blood in eye), black eye, inflammation of uveal tract (uveitis), broken blood vessels (subconjunctival haemorrhage), degenerative joint disorders like rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, spondylosis, spondylarthritis, pain management, maxillofacial surgery, post-traumatic oedema, soft tissue injury, fractures and dislocation, sports injuries, muscle and joint pain with swelling, sciatica, and sprains and strains.

It is also used to manage chronic respiratory diseases like asthma, bronchitis, lung diseases, and sinus infections. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CHYMOTRIP TABLET as it may lead to unwanted effects. CHYMOTRIP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcer, glaucoma, blood clotting disorder, severe liver or kidney disease. CHYMOTRIP TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung diseases, and arrhythmias.

CHYMOTRIP TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless considered necessary. CHYMOTRIP TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. CHYMOTRIP TABLET should be used with caution in children. CHYMOTRIP TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. The most common side effects of taking CHYMOTRIP TABLET are nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, bloating, allergy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CHYMOTRIP TABLET Works

CHYMOTRIP TABLET works by breaking down the proteins and helps to fight infection and hasten the repair of traumatic, surgical or orthopaedic injuries. It also breaks down the blood clots thus improving and restoring circulation and resolves oedema, hematoma and pain, promotes the removal of the debris and accelerates recovery. It also reduces swelling (oedema), and inflammation, by reducing the proinflammatory mediators and fastens the healing process.

Introduction About ENRACTIN NEO D TABLET

ENRACTIN NEO D TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, Trypsin and Diclofenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteases, Flavonoids, Proteolytic enzymes and Analgesics respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, sports injuries, tooth extraction. ENRACTIN NEO D TABLET is also used to manage post-surgical inflammation and helps in wound healing and has an anti-scarring effect.

Prior to starting the management with ENRACTIN NEO D TABLET, your doctor might want you to take up several diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

ENRACTIN NEO D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney or liver disorders, high blood pressure, bleeding or clotting disorders, blood in vomiting or urine and infection. It should be taken with caution in patients who have heart disease.

The most common side effects of taking ENRACTIN NEO D TABLET are nausea, loss of appetite, headache, diarrhoea and flatulence. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

introduction:
Introduction About XYMOHEAL FORTE TABLET

XYMOHEAL FORTE TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes and Flavonoids, respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint issues related to inflammation, pain and swelling of joints, swelling associated with surgical wounds, pulmonary edema, ulcerative colitis, sports and accidental injuries, muscular cramps and spasms, tendinitis, bursitis, dental extraction, sinusitis, bronchitis, and rhinitis. 

Prior to starting the management with XYMOHEAL FORTE TABLET, your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests to understand your existing condition and to safely use this medicine to manage the risk of any unusual effects. 

XYMOHEAL FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with hemophilia (a disorder in which blood doesn't clot normally), liver or kidney disorders, or patients undergoing haemodialysis. XYMOHEAL FORTE TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with any bleeding disorders and heart disease. 

XYMOHEAL FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no data on the use of XYMOHEAL FORTE TABLET in children or elderly patients; hence, always consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. 

The most common side effects of taking XYMOHEAL FORTE TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, tiredness, dry mouth, and skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About RUTOHEAL D TABLET

RUTOHEAL D TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, Trypsin and Diclofenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteases, Flavonoids, Proteolytic enzymes and Analgesics respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, sports injuries, tooth extraction. RUTOHEAL D TABLET is also used to manage post-surgical inflammation and helps in wound healing and has an anti-scarring effect.

Prior to starting the management with RUTOHEAL D TABLET, your doctor might want you to take up several diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

RUTOHEAL D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney or liver disorders, high blood pressure, bleeding or clotting disorders, blood in vomiting or urine and infection. It should be taken with caution in patients who have heart disease.

RUTOHEAL D TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. There is no data on the use of RUTOHEAL D TABLET in children and elderly patients hence, caution must be exercised while taking this medicine. Always, consult with your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RUTOHEAL D TABLET are nausea, loss of appetite, headache, diarrhoea and flatulence. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

Provides relief from pain and inflammation
mechanismOfAction:
How RUTOHEAL D TABLET Works

RUTOHEAL D TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain is a protease enzyme which decreases inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreases their ability to break down. Diclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug which acts by stopping the release of certain chemicals called prostaglandins which is responsible for the occurrence of pain and inflammation.

name: ZORIFEN MR Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ZORIFEN MR TABLET

ZORIFEN MR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Cyclobenzaprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and Skeletal muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to relieve muscle spasm associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis (inflammation of the spine).

Osteoarthritis is defined as a progressive disorder affecting primarily weight-bearing joints, characterized by progressive worsening and loss of cartilage that join bones, pain, motion restriction, deformity and disability.

Rheumatoid arthritis is a long-term, progressive inflammatory disorder of unknown cause characterized by polyarticular (five or more joints) joint involvement and systemic symptoms like tiredness, weakness, fever, loss of appetite and joint pain.

Before taking ZORIFEN MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any severe kidney, heart, liver or thyroid problems or if you have stomach ulcers or bleeding problems.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIFLAME TABLET

TRIFLAME TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, Trypsin and Diclofenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteases, Flavonoids, Proteolytic enzymes and Analgesics respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, sports injuries, tooth extraction. TRIFLAME TABLET is also used to manage post-surgical inflammation and helps in wound healing and has an anti-scarring effect.

Prior to starting the management with TRIFLAME TABLET, your doctor might want you to take up several diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

TRIFLAME TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney or liver disorders, high blood pressure, bleeding or clotting disorders, blood in vomiting or urine and infection. It should be taken with caution in patients who have heart disease.

TRIFLAME TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. There is no data on the use of TRIFLAME TABLET in children and elderly patients hence, caution must be exercised while taking this medicine. Always, consult with your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking TRIFLAME TABLET are nausea, loss of appetite, headache, diarrhoea and flatulence. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

Uses Of TRIFLAME TABLET
Provides relief from pain and inflammation
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIFLAME TABLET Works

TRIFLAME TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain is a protease enzyme which decreases inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreases their ability to break down. Diclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug which acts by stopping the release of certain chemicals called prostaglandins which is responsible for the occurrence of pain and inflammation.

CHYMOCIP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcer, glaucoma, blood clotting disorder, severe liver or kidney disease. introduction:
Introduction About CHYMOWIN ABR TABLET

CHYMOWIN ABR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin which belongs to the group of Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), Protein-digesting enzymes and Herbal analgesic respectively. It is used to manage pain and inflammation related to osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and tendonitis. This medicine is also used to manage conditions such as edema and inflammation following surgeries of cellulitis, sports injuries, tooth extractions, and sprains.

Inflammation is the body’s immune system’s response to an irritant or injury, characterized by redness, heat, swelling, pain, or loss of function. There are no clinical information of safety and efficacy supporting CHYMOWIN ABR TABLET use in pregnancy, breastfeeding, and children so, consult your doctor before taking it.

Before taking CHYMOWIN ABR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any severe liver, kidney, heart, or coagulation problems, stomach or intestinal bleeding. CHYMOWIN ABR TABLET relieves inflammation where aceclofenac blocks the release of certain chemical messengers in the brain (cyclooxygenase 2) responsible for inducing pain and inflammation, trypsin breaks down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, bromelain reduces inflammatory cell (neutrophils) migration and pro-inflammatory cytokines secretion, and rutoside blocks pro-inflammatory genes transcription in human macrophages (type of inflammatory cells).

name: GO NZYMES Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About GO NZYMES TABLET

GO NZYMES TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes and Flavonoids, respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint issues related to inflammation, pain and swelling of joints, swelling associated with surgical wounds, pulmonary edema, ulcerative colitis, sports and accidental injuries, muscular cramps and spasms, tendinitis, bursitis, dental extraction, sinusitis, bronchitis, and rhinitis. 

Prior to starting the management with GO NZYMES TABLET, your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests to understand your existing condition and to safely use this medicine to manage the risk of any unusual effects. 

GO NZYMES TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with hemophilia (a disorder in which blood doesn't clot normally), liver or kidney disorders, or patients undergoing haemodialysis. GO NZYMES TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with any bleeding disorders and heart disease. 

GO NZYMES TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no data on the use of GO NZYMES TABLET in children or elderly patients; hence, always consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. 

The most common side effects of taking GO NZYMES TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, tiredness, dry mouth, and skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GO NZYMES TABLET

Used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with the following:

Osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout
Joint issues related to inflammation
Pain and swelling of joints
Swelling associated with surgical wounds
Pulmonary edema
Ulcerative colitis
Sports and accidental injuries
Muscular cramps and spasms
Tendinitis and bursitis
Dental extraction
Sinusitis, bronchitis, and rhinitis
mechanismOfAction:
How GO NZYMES TABLET Works

GO NZYMES TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain and trypsin are protease enzymes that decrease inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreasing their ability to break down.
usageDetails:

Take GO NZYMES TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of GO NZYMES TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes and Flavonoids, respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint issues related to inflammation, pain and swelling of joints, swelling associated with surgical wounds, pulmonary edema, ulcerative colitis, sports and accidental injuries, muscular cramps and spasms, tendinitis, bursitis, dental extraction, sinusitis, bronchitis, and rhinitis. 

Prior to starting the management with ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET, your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests to understand your existing condition and to safely use this medicine to manage the risk of any unusual effects. 

ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with hemophilia (a disorder in which blood doesn't clot normally), liver or kidney disorders, or patients undergoing haemodialysis. ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with any bleeding disorders and heart disease. 

ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no data on the use of ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET in children or elderly patients; hence, always consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. 

The most common side effects of taking ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, tiredness, dry mouth, and skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET Works

ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain and trypsin are protease enzymes that decrease inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreasing their ability to break down.
usageDetails:
How to use ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET

Take ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ENZOMAC FORTE TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Etoriflex MR 8mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET

ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.
uses: Used to reduce pain, swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm

How ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET Works

ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET reduces pain and swelling in the joints and muscles, whereas Etoricoxib works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause pain and inflammation and Thiocolchicoside works on the centers in the brain and spinal cord to relieve muscle stiffness or spasm and improves pain and movement of muscles.

warnings.details: ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor for advice.
ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness or sleepiness. Consult your doctor for advice.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine because it can aggravate your existing condition.
ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor for advice.
ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not take ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET if you are allergic to Etoricoxib, Thiocolchicoside or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have or had high blood pressure that has not been controlled by management, heart problems (heart failure), angina (chest pain), heart attack or bypass surgery. It should be used with caution if you have any mild to moderate heart problems. Consult your doctor for advice.
ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 16 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ETORIFLEX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have stomach ulcer or bleeding in the stomach or intestines
Have Crohn’s disease, Ulcerative colitis, or Colitis (inflammatory bowel disease)
Have any kind of stroke, and muscles problems
Have peripheral arterial disease

Tell your physician before taking this medicine if you:

Had dehydration (a prolonged bout of vomiting or diarrhea)
Had swelling due to fluid retention
Have being managed for an infection
Have high cholesterol, diabetes
Are a smoker
Have epilepsy

name: Enzictra DS Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ENZICTRA DS TABLET

ENZICTRA DS TABLET contains Bromelain, Papain, Rutoside, and Trypsin which belongs to the group of medicines called Plant derivatives, and Proteolytic enzyme. It is used in the management of inflammation associated with conditions like post-operative (wound after any surgical procedures which is characterised by pain and redness), and traumatic or injury conditions, rheumatic & degenerative conditions like osteoarthritis, and osteoporosis, strain, sprains, and sports injury, low back pain, and spondylopathies. Arthritis is the tenderness or swelling of one or more joints characterized by pain, stiffness, and reduced movements.

ENZICTRA DS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having liver, and kidney problems and any scheduled surgery. ENZICTRA DS TABLET should be used with caution in patients having asthma. ENZICTRA DS TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. ENZICTRA DS TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children who are at the age of breastfeeding.

The safety and efficacy of ENZICTRA DS TABLET have not been establishes in children below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking ENZICTRA DS TABLET are a burning sensation and constipation. Consult your doctor for advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Manage post-operative and traumatic or injury conditions
Manage rheumatic & degenerative conditions like osteoarthritis, and osteoporosis
Manage strain, sprains, and sports injury, low back pain, and spondylopathies
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How ENZICTRA DS TABLET Works

ENZICTRA DS TABLET helps in managing inflammation associated with various conditions where Bromelain works by inhibiting the substances like prostaglandins, bradykinin and proinflammatory cytokines which are responsible for causing inflammation and thereby speed up the wound healing process.

Papain with its anti-inflammatory effect reduces fluid retention and swelling. Trypsin resolves the signs and symptoms of inflammation by removing the dead tissue cells at the site of trauma and helps in the formation of new tissue or skin growth. Rutoside is an antioxidant, it also restores the strength of blood vessel wall which decrease their ability to break down.
usageDetails:
How to use ENZICTRA DS TABLET

Take ENZICTRA DS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ENZICTRA DS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Common

introduction:
Introduction About ENZOHEAL FORTE TABLET

ENZOHEAL FORTE TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes and Flavonoids, respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint issues related to inflammation, pain and swelling of joints, swelling associated with surgical wounds, pulmonary edema, ulcerative colitis, sports and accidental injuries, muscular cramps and spasms, tendinitis, bursitis, dental extraction, sinusitis, bronchitis, and rhinitis. 

Prior to starting the management with ENZOHEAL FORTE TABLET, your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests to understand your existing condition and to safely use this medicine to manage the risk of any unusual effects. 

ENZOHEAL FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with hemophilia (a disorder in which blood doesn't clot normally), liver or kidney disorders, or patients undergoing haemodialysis. ENZOHEAL FORTE TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with any bleeding disorders and heart disease. 

ENZOHEAL FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no data on the use of ENZOHEAL FORTE TABLET in children or elderly patients; hence, always consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. 

The most common side effects of taking ENZOHEAL FORTE TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, tiredness, dry mouth, and skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ENZOHEAL FORTE TABLET Works

ENZOHEAL FORTE TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain and trypsin are protease enzymes that decrease inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreasing their ability to break down.

introduction:
Introduction About CHYMOWIN DP TABLET

CHYMOWIN DP TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac, Paracetamol and Trypsin Chymotrypsin which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory agents (NSAIDs), Analgesics and Proteolytic Enzymes respectively. It is used to relieve various forms of pain and inflammation in conditions such as surgical trauma, fracture and dislocation, post traumatic oedema, post-operative wounds, gynaecological inflammatory conditions, ENT inflammatory conditions and dental inflammatory conditions.

Avoid smoking and consuming alcohol during the management with CHYMOWIN DP TABLET. It is not recommended for use in patients having liver, kidney, heart, lung diseases, active stomach or intestinal ulcer, bleeding or perforation of the gastrointestinal tract, gastric hemorrhage, and increased eye pressure. CHYMOWIN DP TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have ulcerative colitis, Crohn’s disease, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), hypertension, hyperlipidemia (increased cholesterol levels), diabetes mellitus and clotting disorders.

CHYMOWIN DP TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women. There is limited studies available on the use of this medicine in breastfeeding women. Caution must be exercised while taking CHYMOWIN DP TABLET in children and elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CHYMOWIN DP TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, heartburn, stomach pain, indigestion, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor’s advice if any of these above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:

It is used to relieve pain and inflammation in conditions such as:

mechanismOfAction:
How CHYMOWIN DP TABLET Works

CHYMOWIN DP TABLET helps in managing various pain and inflammatory condition where Diclofenac and Paracetamol works by reducing the effects of prostaglandin (substance produced during injury and inflammation causing pain) thereby blocking the pain signals between the brain and nerve endings. Trypsin Chymotrypsin is a combination of enzymes which break down proteins into smaller fragments, thereby making them available for absorption into the blood and increases blood supply in the affected area and reduce swelling. It also has analgesic effects and reduces the pain which is associated with healing.

introduction:
Introduction About CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET

CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, Trypsin and Diclofenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteases, Flavonoids, Proteolytic enzymes and Analgesics respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, sports injuries, tooth extraction. CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET is also used to manage post-surgical inflammation and helps in wound healing and has an anti-scarring effect.

Prior to starting the management with CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET, your doctor might want you to take up several diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney or liver disorders, high blood pressure, bleeding or clotting disorders, blood in vomiting or urine and infection. It should be taken with caution in patients who have heart disease.

CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. There is no data on the use of CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET in children and elderly patients hence, caution must be exercised while taking this medicine. Always, consult with your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET are nausea, loss of appetite, headache, diarrhoea and flatulence. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Provides relief from pain and inflammation
usesDetails:
Uses Of CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET
Provides relief from pain and inflammation
mechanismOfAction:
How CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET Works

CHYMOWIN DBR TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain is a protease enzyme which decreases inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreases their ability to break down. Diclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug which acts by stopping the release of certain chemicals called prostaglandins which is responsible for the occurrence of pain and inflammation.

introduction:
Introduction About CHYMOVAG FORTE TABLET

CHYMOVAG FORTE TABLET contains Trypsin-Chymotrypsin which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes. It is used to manage post-operative wounds, necrotic tissue, oedema and haematomas like auricular septal hematoma, nasal fractures, parapharyngeal abscess, management of inflammation of the surgical stitches, pelvic inflammatory disease, caesarean section, episiotomy, hysterectomy, tooth extraction, peri-apical abscess, ocular trauma include fluid build-up in the macula (macular oedema), hyphema (collection of blood in eye), black eye, inflammation of uveal tract (uveitis), broken blood vessels (subconjunctival haemorrhage), degenerative joint disorders like rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, spondylosis, spondylarthritis, pain management, maxillofacial surgery, post-traumatic oedema, soft tissue injury, fractures and dislocation, sports injuries, muscle and joint pain with swelling, sciatica, and sprains and strains.

It is also used to manage chronic respiratory diseases like asthma, bronchitis, lung diseases, and sinus infections. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CHYMOVAG FORTE TABLET as it may lead to unwanted effects. CHYMOVAG FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcer, glaucoma, blood clotting disorder, severe liver or kidney disease. CHYMOVAG FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung diseases, and arrhythmias.

name: Debrilyse Forte Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DEBRILYSE FORTE TABLET

DEBRILYSE FORTE TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes and Flavonoids, respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint issues related to inflammation, pain and swelling of joints, swelling associated with surgical wounds, pulmonary edema, ulcerative colitis, sports and accidental injuries, muscular cramps and spasms, tendinitis, bursitis, dental extraction, sinusitis, bronchitis, and rhinitis. 

Prior to starting the management with DEBRILYSE FORTE TABLET, your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests to understand your existing condition and to safely use this medicine to manage the risk of any unusual effects. 

DEBRILYSE FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with hemophilia (a disorder in which blood doesn't clot normally), liver or kidney disorders, or patients undergoing haemodialysis. DEBRILYSE FORTE TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with any bleeding disorders and heart disease. 

DEBRILYSE FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no data on the use of DEBRILYSE FORTE TABLET in children or elderly patients; hence, always consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. 

The most common side effects of taking DEBRILYSE FORTE TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, tiredness, dry mouth, and skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEBRILYSE FORTE TABLET Works

DEBRILYSE FORTE TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain and trypsin are protease enzymes that decrease inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreasing their ability to break down.

introduction:
Introduction About CHYMOMERG A TABLET

CHYMOMERG A TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin which belongs to the group of Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), Protein-digesting enzymes and Herbal analgesic respectively. It is used to manage pain and inflammation related to osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and tendonitis. This medicine is also used to manage conditions such as edema and inflammation following surgeries of cellulitis, sports injuries, tooth extractions, and sprains.

Inflammation is the body’s immune system’s response to an irritant or injury, characterized by redness, heat, swelling, pain, or loss of function. There are no clinical information of safety and efficacy supporting CHYMOMERG A TABLET use in pregnancy, breastfeeding, and children so, consult your doctor before taking it.

Before taking CHYMOMERG A TABLET inform your doctor if you have any severe liver, kidney, heart, or coagulation problems, stomach or intestinal bleeding. The most common side effects of taking CHYMOMERG A TABLET are temporary stinging or burning sensation, nausea, hives, trouble breathing, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhea, loss of balance, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CHYMOMERG A TABLET

It is used to manage inflammation associated with rheumatic and degenerative conditions such as:

Rheumatoid arthritis
Osteoarthritis
Spondylopathies
Tendonitis
Bursitis
mechanismOfAction:
How CHYMOMERG A TABLET Works

CHYMOMERG A TABLET relieves inflammation where aceclofenac blocks the release of certain chemical messengers in the brain (cyclooxygenase 2) responsible for inducing pain and inflammation, trypsin breaks down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, bromelain reduces inflammatory cell (neutrophils) migration and pro-inflammatory cytokines secretion, and rutoside blocks pro-inflammatory genes transcription in human macrophages (type of inflammatory cells).

Take CHYMOMERG A TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CHYMOMERG A TABLET according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLPAZEN TABLET

TOLPAZEN TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin which belongs to the group of Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), Protein-digesting enzymes and Herbal analgesic respectively. It is used to manage pain and inflammation related to osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and tendonitis. This medicine is also used to manage conditions such as edema and inflammation following surgeries of cellulitis, sports injuries, tooth extractions, and sprains.

Inflammation is the body’s immune system’s response to an irritant or injury, characterized by redness, heat, swelling, pain, or loss of function. There are no clinical information of safety and efficacy supporting TOLPAZEN TABLET use in pregnancy, breastfeeding, and children so, consult your doctor before taking it.

Before taking TOLPAZEN TABLET inform your doctor if you have any severe liver, kidney, heart, or coagulation problems, stomach or intestinal bleeding. The most common side effects of taking TOLPAZEN TABLET are temporary stinging or burning sensation, nausea, hives, trouble breathing, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhea, loss of balance, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLPAZEN TABLET

It is used to manage inflammation associated with rheumatic and degenerative conditions such as:

Rheumatoid arthritis
Osteoarthritis
Spondylopathies
Tendonitis
Bursitis
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLPAZEN TABLET Works

TOLPAZEN TABLET relieves inflammation where aceclofenac blocks the release of certain chemical messengers in the brain (cyclooxygenase 2) responsible for inducing pain and inflammation, trypsin breaks down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, bromelain reduces inflammatory cell (neutrophils) migration and pro-inflammatory cytokines secretion, and rutoside blocks pro-inflammatory genes transcription in human macrophages (type of inflammatory cells).
usageDetails:
How to use TOLPAZEN TABLET

Take TOLPAZEN TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TOLPAZEN TABLET according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About CHYMOWIN AP TABLET

CHYMOWIN AP TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Trypsin Chymotrypsin which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs, Analgesic and Antipyretic agents and Proteolytic enzymes respectively. It is used for acute or chronic osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and spondylo arthritis, spondylosis and other ortho-degenerative disorders, pain management. This medicine is also used for acute traumatic injury, post operative wounds, dental abscess, acute suppurative otitis media, caesarean section/episiotomy, sciatica (pain long the path of sciatica nerve which from lower back to legs) and sports injury.

Arthritis is the tenderness or swelling of one or more joints characterized by pain, stiffness, and reduced movements. Do not take CHYMOWIN AP TABLET if you have liver, kidney, and heart problems. CHYMOWIN AP TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding woman. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CHYMOWIN AP TABLET is not recommended for use in children and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The common side effects of taking CHYMOWIN AP TABLET are headache, nausea, constipation, wind, indigestion, diarrhoea, abdominal pain. Consult your doctor if the symptoms does not improve.
usesDetails:

Acute or chronic osteoarthritis
Rheumatoid arthritis

mechanismOfAction:
How CHYMOWIN AP TABLET Works

CHYMOWIN AP TABLET produces analgesic (painkiller) effects where Aceclofenac and paracetamol works by blocking the effects of prostaglandin (substance produced during injury and inflammation causing pain) thereby inhibits pain signals between the brain and nerve endings. Trypsin chymotrypsin resolves the signs and symptoms of inflammation due to tissue injury and facilitate the repair process through its anti-inflammatory and fibrinolytic properties.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLPAZEN A TABLET

TOLPAZEN A TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Bromelain, Rutoside, and Trypsin which belongs to the group of Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), Protein-digesting enzymes and Herbal analgesic respectively. It is used to manage pain and inflammation related to osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and tendonitis. This medicine is also used to manage conditions such as edema and inflammation following surgeries of cellulitis, sports injuries, tooth extractions, and sprains.

Inflammation is the body’s immune system’s response to an irritant or injury, characterized by redness, heat, swelling, pain, or loss of function. There are no clinical information of safety and efficacy supporting TOLPAZEN A TABLET use in pregnancy, breastfeeding, and children so, consult your doctor before taking it.

Before taking TOLPAZEN A TABLET inform your doctor if you have any severe liver, kidney, heart, or coagulation problems, stomach or intestinal bleeding. The most common side effects of taking TOLPAZEN A TABLET are temporary stinging or burning sensation, nausea, hives, trouble breathing, indigestion, stomach pain, diarrhea, loss of balance, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLPAZEN A TABLET

It is used to manage inflammation associated with rheumatic and degenerative conditions such as:

Rheumatoid arthritis
Osteoarthritis
Spondylopathies
Tendonitis
Bursitis
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLPAZEN A TABLET Works

TOLPAZEN A TABLET relieves inflammation where aceclofenac blocks the release of certain chemical messengers in the brain (cyclooxygenase 2) responsible for inducing pain and inflammation, trypsin breaks down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, bromelain reduces inflammatory cell (neutrophils) migration and pro-inflammatory cytokines secretion, and rutoside blocks pro-inflammatory genes transcription in human macrophages (type of inflammatory cells).
usageDetails:
How to use TOLPAZEN A TABLET

Take TOLPAZEN A TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TOLPAZEN A TABLET according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET

DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET is a combination of Bromelain, Rutoside, Trypsin and Diclofenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteases, Flavonoids, Proteolytic enzymes and Analgesics respectively. It is used in the management of pain and inflammation associated with rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, sports injuries, tooth extraction. DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET is also used to manage post-surgical inflammation and helps in wound healing and has an anti-scarring effect.

Prior to starting the management with DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET, your doctor might want you to take up several diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney or liver disorders, high blood pressure, bleeding or clotting disorders, blood in vomiting or urine and infection. It should be taken with caution in patients who have heart disease.

DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. There is no data on the use of DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET in children and elderly patients hence, caution must be exercised while taking this medicine. Always, consult with your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET are nausea, loss of appetite, headache, diarrhoea and flatulence. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Provides relief from pain and inflammation
usesDetails:
Uses Of DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET
Provides relief from pain and inflammation
mechanismOfAction:
How DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET Works

DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET helps in managing pain and inflammation associated with various conditions where bromelain is a protease enzyme which decreases inflammation by inhibiting the substances that are responsible for it called proinflammatory prostaglandins. It also influences blood clotting by increasing the activity of a protein called fibrinogen. Rutoside is a flavonoid that works by enhancing the strength of blood vessels and decreases their ability to break down. Diclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug which acts by stopping the release of certain chemicals called prostaglandins which is responsible for the occurrence of pain and inflammation.

Take DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DEBRILYSE PLUS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRYPLE FORTE TABLET

TRYPLE FORTE TABLET contains Trypsin-Chymotrypsin which belongs to the group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes. It is used to manage post-operative wounds, necrotic tissue, oedema and haematomas like auricular septal hematoma, nasal fractures, parapharyngeal abscess, management of inflammation of the surgical stitches, pelvic inflammatory disease, caesarean section, episiotomy, hysterectomy, tooth extraction, peri-apical abscess, ocular trauma include fluid build-up in the macula (macular oedema), hyphema (collection of blood in eye), black eye, inflammation of uveal tract (uveitis), broken blood vessels (subconjunctival haemorrhage), degenerative joint disorders like rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, spondylosis, spondylarthritis, pain management, maxillofacial surgery, post-traumatic oedema, soft tissue injury, fractures and dislocation, sports injuries, muscle and joint pain with swelling, sciatica, and sprains and strains.

It is also used to manage chronic respiratory diseases like asthma, bronchitis, lung diseases, and sinus infections. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TRYPLE FORTE TABLET as it may lead to unwanted effects. TRYPLE FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcer, glaucoma, blood clotting disorder, severe liver or kidney disease. TRYPLE FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung diseases, and arrhythmias.

How TRYPLE FORTE TABLET Works

TRYPLE FORTE TABLET works by breaking down the proteins and helps to fight infection and hasten the repair of traumatic, surgical or orthopaedic injuries. It also breaks down the blood clots thus improving and restoring circulation and resolves oedema, hematoma and pain, promotes the removal of the debris and accelerates recovery. Introduction About CUZEN 10 TABLET

CUZEN 10 TABLET contains Serratiopeptidase, which belongs to a group of medicines called Proteolytic enzymes (protease). It is used to relieve inflammation in conditions such as following surgery and trauma, engorgement of the breast, bladder, tube that carries sperm from the testes, gum tissue of the wisdom tooth, nasal sinus, tooth abscess (pus), and also used in the management of inflammation of the airways that carry air to the lungs, pulmonary tuberculosis (infection of the lungs), asthma, and following anaesthesia.

Do not take CUZEN 10 TABLET if you have a gastric ulcer. Before taking this CUZEN 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or have had any kidney, liver, or heart problems.
